sn46.42:1.1: Rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā sattannam ratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ || || Cakkaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || hatthiratanassaassaratanassa || maṇiratanassa || itthiratanassa || gahapatiratanassa- || parināyakaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || || Rañño bhikkhave cakkavattissa pātubhāvā imesaṃ sattannam ratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || ||
sn46.42:2.1: Tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa sattannam bojjhaṅgaratanānam pātubhāvo hoti || || Katamesaṃ sattannaṃ || || Satisambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhāvo hoti || la-pe || || Upekhāsambojjhaṅgaratanassa pātubhavo hoti || || Tathāgatassa bhikkhave pātubhāvā arahato sammāsambuddhassa imesaṃ sattannam bojjhaṅgaratanānaṃ pātubhāvo hoti ti || || Mārasenapamaddanaṃ
